intent: A closing call to action on a dark panel where a sunrise is drawn in ordered (Bayer) dither: light quantised into a few colours, a crisp horizon hairline and a scanline reflection. Calm, graphic, premium.

layout.panel: rounded 24px (32px sm+), #09090b, inset top highlight, 1px white/6% ring, min-height 560/640/700px
layout.content: centred column; notes pinned to the bottom with mt-auto
layout.horizon: 40px above the first note, re-measured every frame

color.levels: panel black → outer at 45% → outer → mid → core, chosen per cell with an 8×8 Bayer threshold
color.hairline: white up to 70% under the sun, fading to 0 within 38% of the width either side

motion.rise: sun rises over 1.8s on first view, ease-out expo
motion.shimmer: multiplies existing light ±14% with two slow sines; never adds light to dark areas
motion.lean: up to 6% of the width toward a mouse pointer, eased
motion.fps: 30, paused offscreen and in hidden tabs
motion.copy: headline blur 8px→0 + 18px rise over 0.9s; body +120ms, buttons +200ms, notes 80ms apart after 500ms
motion.primaryHover: a blurred accent glow fades in beneath the button and the arrow nudges 2px; press 0.98; no magnetism or lift
motion.reducedMotion: one still frame (redrawn on resize); no entrances

responsive.mobile: buttons full width and stacked; notes stacked; bloom 130% wide

content.headline: Ship the version you’d be proud to demo.

avoid: glowing planet arcs or purple-blue blobs
light reaching the headline or body copy
dither noise in dark areas (shimmer must be multiplicative)
blurred/smoothed scaling of the dither canvas
